name: Oryzon Genomics S.A.
summary: Oryzon Genomics S.A., a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, engages in the discovery and development of epigenetics-based therapeutics for patients with cancer and CNS (central nervous system), oncology, and hematology disorders. Its clinical phase compounds include iadademstat (ORY-1001), a selective LSD1 inhibitor that is in Phase II trials for oncology; and vafidemstat (ORY-2001), a CNS-optimized LSD1 inhibitor, which is in Phase II trials for the treatment of CNS and psychiatric diseases.
